sports_basic.name: sports_basic
sports_basic.description: A starter sports preset built around widely used public sports feeds.
notes: Useful for broad sports monitoring and league headline tracking.
Pair with official league/team sources when settlement accuracy matters.

crypto_basic.name: crypto_basic
crypto_basic.description: A starter crypto preset with one verified crypto newsroom feed and crypto-native providers.
notes: Pair with protocol, issuer, or exchange sources for higher-confidence workflows.
You can add more crypto feeds through TEE_FEED_URLS without changing the preset file.

macro_basic.name: macro_basic
macro_basic.description: A macro/central-bank preset built around official Federal Reserve feeds.
notes: Good for rate decisions, policy statements, and official Fed releases.
Add Treasury, BLS, or other official feeds through TEE_FEED_URLS as needed.

equity_basic.name: equity_basic
equity_basic.description: A stock/equity preset focused on quote APIs and broad business-news discovery.
notes: This preset relies more on Alpha Vantage and search than on bundled feeds.
Add company IR feeds or business-news feeds through TEE_FEED_URLS for richer coverage.
